intended_body:
Depends on #38 (`86060d5`); please review only the final commit, `a3e17bf`.

Addresses #17. `pp_declars` flattened name components, so valid quoted names could be missed or printed with the wrong boundaries. This compares requested names component-wise and escapes each printed component independently, while preserving anonymous-name syntax.

Two focused regressions fail on unchanged #38 and pass here; all 60 tests pass.

[Lean Assurance Lab report](https://github.com/phiferd/lean-assurance-lab/blob/9474e63ecbd3d82511a2064af69ace91a1c1ac67/results/research/nanoda-quoted-name-contract-2026-10-03/report.md)
